cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(maintenance_entry LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Core Gui Network Qml)
add_executable(maintenance_entry main.cpp "${EDI_ROOT}/app/src/desktop_updates.cpp")
target_include_directories(maintenance_entry PRIVATE "${EDI_ROOT}/app/src" "${EDI_ROOT}/core/include")
target_link_libraries(maintenance_entry PRIVATE Qt6::Core Qt6::Gui Qt6::Network Qt6::Qml)
target_sources(maintenance_entry PRIVATE "${EDI_ROOT}/app/src/app_info.hpp")
target_compile_options(maintenance_entry PRIVATE -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections)
if(APPLE)
    target_link_options(maintenance_entry PRIVATE -Wl,-dead_strip)
else()
    target_link_options(maintenance_entry PRIVATE -Wl,--gc-sections)
endif()
